_note: BUILDING-FACE-POSE-1. mc2_05 non-degradation set. mc2_05 is the only tier map that runs a real day/night cycle (DayToNightTime = 864000 in the mission .fit, versus -1 on mc2_01/03/10/24) and its night lighting is USER-APPROVED, so any prop-lighting change has to be shown NOT to damage it -- but no mc2_05 bookmark set existed in this directory at all, which left that claim unverifiable. This file closes that hole. Sites are building-class object clusters read out of the mission .pak packet-1 object list and classified by ObjectTypeClass (method note in mc2_10_building_faces.json): 'liao_compound' = the 82-object walled compound at (-4009,-2751) (Liao medium walls and gates, SRM turrets, large fuel tanks, HeavyIndustrial); 'east_compound' = the 82-object walled compound at (3133,-1788); 'spotlight_yard' = the 34-object cluster at (-236,448) carrying LiaoSpotlight and its control, i.e. the object-light fixtures whose night pools are the approved look; 'refinery' = the 34-object plant at (-1006,4587). Sun azimuth = LightDirYaw(15)+45 = 60 deg. The control frames terrain carrying no building-class object.
